title: Subway Surfers
blurb: An endless runner from 2012 became the background of the entire internet, which nobody involved could possibly have planned. Subway Surfers footage is the standard filler in the bottom half of a split-screen video, running silently under a narrated Reddit story while your attention has nowhere else to go. SYBO and Kiloo made a perfectly good mobile game — and accidentally invented a genre of visual chewing gum. This clip is the audio half of that phenomenon. Attach it to anything and it reads instantly as the second half of a TikTok.
origin: Audio from Subway Surfers (SYBO and Kiloo, 2012).
